title: The Blood Trail
text: Fresh blood on the leaves, splashed high on the trunks, a lot of it. The quarry is wounded, and it was not you who did it. Something else in these woods hunts the thing you are hunting, and it does not care to share.

options.label: Follow fast while it bleeds, before the other hunter claims it.

outcomes.text: You catch it while it is weak, and it is still very dangerous, and very afraid.

options.label: The sharpest eye looks for what wounded it first, wary of a rival hunter.

outcomes.text: A rival House's arrow, snapped off in the bark. You know who hunts your quarry now.
Something bigger, and it has been following the blood too, and now it has found you instead.

options.label: Let it bleed out in its own time. The woods will do your work for you.

outcomes.text: It goes to ground, weaker, and angrier. You hear it moaning at night, and the sound gets into your dreams.
